name: qa-swarm
description: Run a parallel specialist code review, produce ranked evidence-backed findings and a test plan, then implement selected fixes through a test-first loop.

interface.shortDescription: Review and fix code with specialist agents
interface.longDescription: Deploy focused security, correctness, performance, architecture, data-flow, and concurrency reviewers in parallel; rank and corroborate concrete findings; generate a fix spec and test plan; and implement selected fixes through a test-first loop.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository for security and correctness bugs.
Run a QA swarm over the most risky parts of this codebase.
Implement selected findings from this QA Swarm report.
